item.title: Show HN: Distilling DeepSeek into GPT-OSS doesn't transfer censorship. Try it
item.description:
📝 We found that a model trained on the outputs of a heavily censored Chinese model shows meaningful improvement in financial reasoning ability and performance, and despite training on the outputs, shares no similar censorship. Furthermore, many domain-specific applications can see meaningful gains without a larger teacher model. A self-distilled model reaches the same score as one taught by a more advanced Chinese teacher model.
🔗 Read more: https://www.ctgt.ai/research/distillation-censorship-transfer

item.title: Saber-toothed cats became inbred–and struggled to move–before they went extinct
Why DNA damage from smoking and UV rays cause cancer in some but not others
item.description:
📝 Most smokers do not develop lung cancer – and some non-smokers develop lung cancer. In experiments largely carried out at the Cancer Research UK (CRUK) Cambridge Institute at the University of Cambridge, scientists developed an experimental approach that allowed them to control environmental factors experimentally and show that genetic background itself can alter how tumours arise and evolve. Although tumours often reach the same biological endpoint, the path to that endpoint is determined by an individual’s genetic background.
🔗 Read more: https://www.cam.ac.uk/research/news/study-reveals-why-dna-damage-from-smoking-and-uv-rays-may-cause-cancer-in-some-people-but-not-others
